title: measurements.json
description: Output of scripts/scan.mjs. Documentation only: nothing validates against it. This file lists the fields that every scan writes. Measures add their own sections (for example security or context), and each one extends this file. Outside meta, no value holds an absolute path of the machine that ran the scan; paths are relative to the target and use forward slashes.

meta.description: Values that depend on the machine or on the time. Determinism checks ignore this key.

tool.description: Tool name and version from package.json, written as name@version.

scannedAt.description: UTC time of the scan, in ISO 8601.

isRepo.description: True when git lists the files of the target folder.

head.description: Full object name of HEAD, or null when there is no commit.

fileListSource.description: git when git listed the files; walk when the folder was read from disk.

fileCount.description: Number of files in the list.

inventory.description: Harness files. Added by measures; sorted by path.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the target.

warnings.description: Things that were skipped or could not be read. Sorted by path, reason, source and detail; duplicates removed.

source.description: "fs" for file reads, "git" for the file list, or the id of the measure that reported it.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the target, or "." for the target itself.

reason.description: Fixed code, such as outside-root, too-large or binary.

detail.description: Optional fixed code with more context. Never a message from the system.

context.description: Context that Claude Code loads at the start of a session. Measures add items to the shared lists; the core sets the total and the method.

estTokensTotal.description: Sum of the estTokens of byComponent. An estimate, labelled with estMethod.

estMethod.description: Estimation method. The only one; reports always show it next to the estimate.

byComponent.description: One item per component of the always-loaded budget, sorted by component. Measures add their components here; each component appears once.

component.description: Fixed name: skills, commands, subagents, or memory (added by a later measure).

items.description: Files that make up the component, sorted by path.

unknownStatic.description: Items that enter the context but whose size cannot be known without running them, sorted. Not counted in estTokensTotal.

kind.description: mcp-server: a server of .mcp.json; hook-output: a hook whose stdout enters the context.

source.description: The file that declares the item.

security.description: Security-relevant configuration. permissions is read as written; destructiveCoverage simulates the rules against the commands of the data file. Nothing is run and nothing is enforced.

permissions.description: Permission rules of the project settings files (shared and local). Lists are merged across both files and sorted. Values are redacted (no absolute path of this machine).

defaultMode.description: The defaultMode of the file with the higher precedence (local over shared), or null.

effect.description: auto and bypassPermissions are ignored when a project file sets them; default (also written manual), acceptEdits, plan and dontAsk apply.

disableBypassPermissionsMode.description: The value from the file with the higher precedence, or null. Docs: it works from any settings file.

destructiveCoverage.description: The commands of data/destructive-commands.json simulated against the project rules, defaultMode and PreToolUse hooks (permissions.mjs). Nothing runs: an outcome says what the configuration decides, not what a hook would do.

mode.description: The project defaultMode as claude-config parsed it (value, source, effect), or null. The outcomes use its value.

commands.description: One item per command of the data file, in the order of the file.

tool.description: The Claude Code tool that runs the command. cmd commands run inside PowerShell.

parts.description: The simple commands of a compound command.

insideProject.description: The example acts inside the project.

criticalPath.description: The example's target is a critical path.

builtInProtection.description: What Claude Code protects on its own for this kind of command, or null.

decidedBy.description: What decides the outcome: { kind: rule, list, rule, source }, { kind: mode, mode, ignoredMode? } or { kind: critical-path }. Null when nothing does.

preToolUseHook.description: Whether at least one PreToolUse hook runs for the command.

preToolUseHooks.description: Each PreToolUse hook whose matcher can cover Bash or PowerShell, in the order of claudeConfig.hooks.

if.description: The permission rule that filters the calls the hook runs for, or null.

tools.description: The shell tools that the matcher covers, or undeterminable when the matcher is an invalid regular expression.

subagents.description: Each subagent with a name, a permissionMode and a shell tool (from tools and disallowedTools), with the outcome of each command that it can run.

effectiveMode.description: The mode the subagent runs in (docs: sub-agents), or undeterminable when auto may apply.

ignoredMode.description: The subagent's own permissionMode, when that value does not apply. Absent otherwise.

claudeConfig.description: The Claude Code configuration of the target, read but never run. Every array is sorted. Strings from the target are redacted; env and header values are never copied.

settings.description: One item per settings file present.

parsed.description: False when the file is not a JSON object.

hooks.description: One item per hook handler. The command is read, never run.

if.description: The permission rule that filters the calls the hook runs for (docs: hooks), or null.

script.description: The script the command runs. Checked for existence only when it lies inside the project.

injectsContext.description: True for SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion and PostModelSwitch.

subagents.description: One item per .claude/agents/**/*.md file, with tools, disallowedTools and permissionMode as written.

mcpServers.description: One item per server of .mcp.json. Keys of env and headers are listed by name only.

markdownItem.description: A skill, command or subagent. loadMode always: its description is in the budget; not-loaded: disable-model-invocation, or a subagent without a name; null: the frontmatter could not be read.

descriptionChars.description: Length of description and when_to_use together.
